KaTeX bundled font notices

The following copyright, Reserved Font Name and license statements are transcribed verbatim from name IDs 0, 13 and 14 of the 40 bundled WOFF/WOFF2 files.

These fonts are licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1, not the KaTeX JavaScript MIT license. The complete SIL Open Font License 1.1 is included in this theme at assets/fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt (relative to this notice: ../../fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt). Its OFL license terms also accompany these fonts; its separate copyright statements for other font families do not replace the notices below.
